scope: Managed park/resume integration and admission/retirement fences; no production activation.

DEADLINE_RACE_RESULT.scope: Local PostgreSQL arbitration, event durability and write permissions only

verified_behavior: Managed actor and actual reaper park paths commit a transition before provider requests.
User and autonomous admission serialize with park and reject pending operations even after a stale ready write.
Resume and ready reuse require the original provider instance ID and recheck current ownership and generation.
Managed resume retains existing physical capacity without provider I/O inside the quota transaction.
A refused park/destroy retains the actor connection and does not report successful retirement.
A managed home checkpoint is requested once and its metadata is applied only after successful transition confirmation.
Timeouts retain uncertainty and do not grant replay; task timeouts survive caller death.
Account deletion, owner drift, retirement and stale transition results cannot reopen the sandbox.
Park events and durable notification jobs commit together; a rollback emits no park success.
A delayed co-tenant park message cannot stop an actor after a newer resume generation.

failed_run_corrections.cause: Test fixture tried to set trusted provider identity through the general changeset; corrected to use actual finish_provision.
A stale Ecto fixture write was a no-op; reload before simulating an independent ready write.
Dialyzer found old lifecycle specs promised only :ok; updated them to include enforced refusals.
